description: Get the latest independently verified stored result for one of the caller's trackers, or the latest retained result at or before a requested timestamp. This is read-only, never triggers a live run, and preserves the last good result after a newer failure. To create or manage a tracker, tell the user to open the Equibles Portal and choose Dashboard → Trackers: https://www.equibles.com/trackers

capturedAtOrBefore.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp. Returns the newest retained verified capture completed at or before this instant. Omit it for the latest result.

dataFeed.description: The tracker name or full id shown by ListWebDataFeeds.

name: GetWebDataFeed
title: Get Tracker
